# Condition Desk for Weather-Sensitive Field Operations

Evercraft public capability ID: condition-desk-field-ops-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public handoff: https://systemiacommandcenters.com

## Use this when

- can my crews work tomorrow
- weather go no-go for field crews
- jobsite weather risk
- roofing weather decision
- construction weather operations
- air quality work decision

## Problem

Field teams need operational go/no-go decision support against their own tolerances rather than scattered weather/hazard tabs.

## Inputs

Locations, work type, customer-defined thresholds/tolerances and operating window.

## Outputs

Conditions and hazards evaluated against defined thresholds with source health and evidence snapshot.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Current hypothesis $199-$399/month small team, $499+/month multi-site; not auto-quotable yet.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Decision support only; customer retains operational authority. Payment/subscription requires explicit confirmation.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, or payment state.
